title: research: slot_id staleness after token removal during open session
description: wp11_pkcs11.c key objects store a slot_id (line 299-302). If a token is removed and a new one inserted in the same slot while a session is still open, g_keys[idx].slot_id == s->slot_id may match unintended keys. Research: does the C_CloseSession / C_Logout path clear all keys for the slot before allowing a new login? If not, add a generation counter or epoch to session/key handles to invalidate stale references.
